content: Onboarding norms for crypto bots: create exchange API key with trade + market-data permissions, withdrawals DISABLED, IP allowlist where available; backtest; then paper/dry-run with real-time data. Community guidance is 'paper trade at least two weeks, then scale gradually'. The friction points are the API-key creation detour (user leaves the product to go to Binance and back) and the fact that nothing enforces the paper-trading duration - it is advice, not a gate.
